lines.en: I forget a word. Can you help me?
lines.ko: 단어 하나가 생각이 안 나요. 도와줄래요?

lines.en: Sure. What is it about?
It's a red fruit. We ate it yesterday.
I guess it's 'apple'. Is that right?
Yes! Apple. Now I remember it.
You learned that word last week, I think.
lines.ko: 지난주에 그 단어를 배웠던 것 같아요.

lines.en: I know. My mind is slow today.
Don't worry. I forget words too.
I will write new words in my note.
Good idea. I believe you will remember them.
lines.ko: 좋은 생각이에요. 꼭 기억할 거라고 믿어요.

lines.en: What did you learn at school today?
We learned about the moon, Grandma.
The moon! Do you understand it well?
Yes. Can you imagine walking on the moon?
lines.ko: 네. 달 위를 걷는 걸 상상할 수 있어요?

lines.en: I can't imagine it. I think it's cold there.
lines.ko: 상상이 안 돼요. 거기는 추울 것 같아요.

lines.en: I guess so. My teacher knows many things.
lines.ko: 그럴 것 같아요. 우리 선생님은 아는 게 많아요.

lines.en: When I was young, I believed the moon followed me.
lines.ko: 어릴 때 나는 달이 나를 따라온다고 믿었어요.

lines.en: That's fun! I will remember that.
Don't forget your book. Let's go home.
Okay, Grandma. I will tell you more tomorrow.
lines.ko: 네, 할머니. 내일 더 이야기해 줄게요.
